stepTitle: A sine function crosses the y-axis at $$y=3$$. Its maximum value is $$5$$, and its minimum value is $$1$$. It attains its maximum at $$x=\frac{1}{4}$$ and its minimum at $$x=\frac{\left(-1\right)}{4}$$. \n The function shown is of the form $$y=A\sin(Bx)+D.$$ Identify the vertical shift $$D.$$
